messages:
marta_procure: Vendor just pushed H100 ETA on PO# 2026-12-02 by ~2 weeks. They propose splitting across AMS/FRA (60/40) to reduce hub risk.

eli_ops: FRA customs has been flaky this quarter. Splitting okay but we should protect na-west2 warm spares.

marta_procure: Tentative AWBs: AMS 1Z-AMS-24680, FRA 1Z-FRA-13579. Vendor also flagged RMA-70021 (3 DOA units) at depot.

noah_eng: If AMS can provide loaners we'll accept. Routing idea: prefer AMS for latency-critical pools; pin FRA to batch workloads. I'll draft a canary config to flip routing.

tara_logistics: docbot: AWB 1Z-FRA-13579 - customs hold. Docs needed: commercial invoice + PO. Upload to portal or email customs@carrier.example.

docbot: AWB 1Z-FRA-13579 status: hold. Estimated clearance 48-72h after docs accepted.

eli_ops: RMA options: (A) depot repair (~8-10d) or (B) AMS loaners overnight (~$5.2k). Which is cheaper when considering warm-spare risk?

marta_procure: Asked vendor for written loaner offer + partial freight credit. Waiting on confirmation.

noah_eng: +1 for loaners if vendor confirms. I'll queue routing PR and add p95/p99 dashboards for the canary.

tara_logistics: Uploaded docs at 2026-12-04T13:22Z. Notifying carrier for manual clearance.

docbot: Update: AWB 1Z-FRA-13579 - docs accepted. Clearance ETA ~36h.

marta_procure: Vendor confirmed 3 AMS loaners (7-day loan) AWB 1Z-AMS-LOAN99 and 30% freight credit. Drafting PO amendment.

eli_ops: Great. I'll pause depot repair and accept loaners once they arrive. Action items: tara upload docs (done), marta confirm amendment, noah push routing PR, eli run spare audit and report if any pool <2.

marta_procure: Amendment signed and loaners shipped. Closing thread unless issues. :thumbsup:
